patterns.name: Hono API Layer
patterns.blessed_solution: Hono route composition for worker/backend APIs
patterns.rationale: Typed lightweight router aligned to edge/server runtimes
patterns.anti_patterns: Avoid ad-hoc route registration patterns per handler file

patterns.name: Cloudflare Worker Runtime
patterns.rationale: Cloudflare-native edge execution for APIs and middleware
patterns.anti_patterns: Avoid mixing non-edge runtime assumptions into worker handlers

patterns.name: App Runtime Split
patterns.blessed_solution: Frontend app plus API service/edge runtime split
patterns.rationale: Clear ownership between UI and backend concerns
patterns.anti_patterns: Avoid coupling frontend state logic directly to DB models

patterns.name: Primary Data Store
patterns.blessed_solution: Single primary transactional data layer with migrations
patterns.rationale: Consistent source of truth for read/write paths
patterns.anti_patterns: Avoid duplicating write sources across multiple stores

patterns.name: API Integration Boundary
patterns.rationale: Reduces interface drift between frontend and backend

patterns.name: Background Processing
patterns.blessed_solution: Queue/job model for notifications and batch workflows
patterns.rationale: Protects user-facing latency from long-running tasks
patterns.anti_patterns: Avoid synchronous execution of retry-prone integrations

patterns.name: Security Baseline
patterns.blessed_solution: Centralized authn/authz and secret management policy
patterns.anti_patterns: Avoid mixed auth patterns across services and clients
